_comment: The complete, closed set of validation runs whose retained evidence is
irrecoverably lost and whose append-only correction may therefore carry a
retained-evidence quarantine. envelope and lost_row are the run.result
event in ledger_shard, copied whole: a quarantined row must equal lost_row
in every field except result no_result, source reconstructed and this
entry's marker, and a correction may only supersede the event that
envelope and lost_row describe. A marker a row authors for itself names no
entry and is refused. The quarantined row is never green and no consumer
counts it as an observation. This file grants nothing by itself: only the
one run.correct event per entry appended to ledger_shard, whose legacy_row
is exactly that corrected row, makes the lost run quarantined. The
recorded raw passes stay in the timeline unchanged, and read alone their
missing artifacts are reader faults. Adding an entry is an owner decision,
